value.author: samMularczyk
value.layerInfo: Bleed a background layer's light in around this layer's edges.

size: How far light wraps in from the edge, in pixels.
falloff: Scales the whole blur ladder. Above one pulls the wrap tighter to the edge, below one spreads it further in.
aspect: Stretches the wrap horizontally against vertically.
useLuminance: Only let the brighter parts of the background wrap, rather than all of it.
threshold: How bright the background must be to wrap, when Bright Areas Only is on.
bgSize: Pixel resolution of the background image. Sets where it sits; without it the background reads as almost black.
bgScale: Corrects for the background being shown at a different size to its native resolution. 1.0 if shown at 100%.
gamma: Falloff curve of the wrap from the edge inward.
saturation: Colour strength of the wrapped light.
blend: How the wrap combines with the layer. Effect Only shows the wrap alone.
amount: Mix between the original layer and the wrapped result.
background: The background layer's shader. Nothing happens until this is connected.
